description: This file defines the JNDIContextFactory class, which provides methods to retrieve and cache JNDI InitialContext instances based on server names, utilizing configuration utilities and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: JNDIContextFactory
classes.description: Provides static methods to obtain and manage cached JNDI InitialContext instances based on server configuration.

methods.name: getInitialContext
methods.description: Returns the initial JNDI context for a specified server name, creating and caching it if necessary, with configuration options.

methods.name: clearInitialContext
methods.description: Removes the cached JNDI context for a specified server name from the cache.
